# nah_subnet (Resource)

Manages a NahCloud subnet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nah_subnet" "app" {
  project    = nah_project.app.slug
  network_id = nah_network.app.id
  name       = "app_a"
  cidr       = "10.42.1.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) Canonical private IPv4 CIDR with prefix /16 through /28. Changing it replaces the subnet.
- `name` (String) Resource name.
- `network_id` (String) Opaque parent network ID.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque stable resource ID.
- `project_id` (String) Opaque owning project ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nah_subnet.app my-app/NETWORK_ID/SUBNET_ID
```
